    Deck transformations of ℤΔ → Q #

    Proof of Proposition 4.1, Steps 3 and 4.

    • A map over π preserving arrows is determined by its value at one vertex ("by unique lifting of undirected walks") — eq_of_over.
    • A translation-commuting automorphism of ℤΔ has the form (v, t) ↦ (ρ v, t + c₀) in height coordinates: "Every quiver arrow increases the height by one ... the difference H(Fx) - H(x) is therefore constant along arrows and hence constant on the connected quiver. Its action on translation orbits is a tree automorphism ρ" — height_form.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
